NKJV.1: And God spoke all these words, saying:
NKJV.2: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
NKJV.3: “You shall have no other gods before Me.
NKJV.4: “You shall not make for yourself a carved image—any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth;
NKJV.5: you shall not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
NKJV.6: but showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.
NKJV.7: “You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who takes His name in vain.
NKJV.8: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
NKJV.9: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
NKJV.10: but the seventh day is the Sabbath of the LORD your God. In it you shall do no work: you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger who is within your gates.
NKJV.11: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and hallowed it.
NKJV.12: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long upon the land which the LORD your God is giving you.
NKJV.16: “You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
NKJV.17: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house; you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
NKJV.18: Now all the people witnessed the thunderings, the lightning flashes, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking; and when the people saw it, they trembled and stood afar off.
NKJV.19: Then they said to Moses, “You speak with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die.”
NKJV.20: And Moses said to the people, “Do not fear; for God has come to test you, and that His fear may be before you, so that you may not sin.”
NKJV.21: So the people stood afar off, but Moses drew near the thick darkness where God was.
NKJV.22: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: ‘You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
NKJV.23: You shall not make anything to be with Me—gods of silver or gods of gold you shall not make for yourselves.
NKJV.24: An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and you shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I record My name I will come to you, and I will bless you.
NKJV.25: And if you make Me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone; for if you use your tool on it, you have profaned it.
NKJV.26: Nor shall you go up by steps to My altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed on it.’

WEB.1: God  spoke all these words, saying,
WEB.2: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
WEB.3: “You shall have no other gods before me.
WEB.4: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
WEB.5: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
WEB.6: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
WEB.7: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
WEB.8: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
WEB.9: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
WEB.10: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
WEB.11: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
WEB.12: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
WEB.16: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
WEB.17: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
WEB.18: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
WEB.19: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
WEB.20: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
WEB.21: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
WEB.22: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
WEB.23: You shall most certainly not make alongside of me gods of silver, or gods of gold for yourselves.
WEB.24: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
WEB.25: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
WEB.26: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

NLT.1: Then God gave the people all these instructions :
NLT.2: “I am the LORD your God, who rescued you from the land of Egypt, the place of your slavery.
NLT.3: “You must not have any other god but me.
NLT.4: “You must not make for yourself an idol of any kind or an image of anything in the heavens or on the earth or in the sea.
NLT.5: You must not bow down to them or worship them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God who will not tolerate your affection for any other gods. I lay the sins of the parents upon their children; the entire family is affected — even children in the third and fourth generations of those who reject me.
NLT.6: But I lavish unfailing love for a thousand generations on those who love me and obey my commands.
NLT.7: “You must not misuse the name of the LORD your God. The LORD will not let you go unpunished if you misuse his name.
NLT.8: “Remember to observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
NLT.9: You have six days each week for your ordinary work,
NLT.10: but the seventh day is a Sabbath day of rest dedicated to the LORD your God. On that day no one in your household may do any work. This includes you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, your livestock, and any foreigners living among you.
NLT.11: For in six days the LORD made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and everything in them; but on the seventh day he rested. That is why the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
NLT.12: “Honor your father and mother. Then you will live a long, full life in the land the LORD your God is giving you.
NLT.16: “You must not testify falsely against your neighbor.
NLT.17: “You must not covet your neighbor’s house. You must not covet your neighbor’s wife, male or female servant, ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor.”
NLT.18: When the people heard the thunder and the loud blast of the ram’s horn, and when they saw the flashes of lightning and the smoke billowing from the mountain, they stood at a distance, trembling with fear.
NLT.19: And they said to Moses, “You speak to us, and we will listen. But don’t let God speak directly to us, or we will die!”
NLT.20: “Don’t be afraid,” Moses answered them, “for God has come in this way to test you, and so that your fear of him will keep you from sinning!”
NLT.21: As the people stood in the distance, Moses approached the dark cloud where God was.
NLT.22: And the LORD said to Moses, “Say this to the people of Israel: You saw for yourselves that I spoke to you from heaven.
NLT.23: Remember, you must not make any idols of silver or gold to rival me.
NLT.24: “Build for me an altar made of earth, and offer your sacrifices to me — your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats, and your cattle. Build my altar wherever I cause my name to be remembered, and I will come to you and bless you.
NLT.25: If you use stones to build my altar, use only natural, uncut stones. Do not shape the stones with a tool, for that would make the altar unfit for holy use.
NLT.26: And do not approach my altar by going up steps. If you do, someone might look up under your clothing and see your nakedness.

AMP.1: Then God spoke all these words:
AMP.2: "I am the LORD your God, who has brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
AMP.3: "You shall have no other gods before Me.
AMP.4: "You shall not make for yourself any idol, or any likeness (form, manifestation) of what is in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the water under the earth [as an object to worship].
AMP.5: You shall not worship them nor serve them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous (impassioned) God [ demanding what is rightfully and uniquely mine], visiting (avenging) the iniquity (sin, guilt) of the fathers on the children [that is, calling the children to account for the sins of their fathers], to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
AMP.6: but showing graciousness and steadfast lovingkindness to thousands [of generations] of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
AMP.7: "You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain [that is, irreverently, in false affirmations or in ways that impugn the character of God]; for the LORD will not hold guiltless nor leave unpunished the one who takes His name in vain [disregarding its reverence and its power].
AMP.8: "Remember the Sabbath (seventh) day to keep it holy (set apart, dedicated to God).
AMP.9: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
AMP.10: but the seventh day is a Sabbath [a day of rest dedicated] to the LORD your God; on that day you shall not do any work, you or your son, or your daughter, or your male servant, or your female servant, or your livestock or the temporary resident (foreigner) who stays within your [city] gates.
AMP.11: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea and everything that is in them, and He rested (ceased) on the seventh day. That is why the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy [that is, set it apart for His purposes].
AMP.12: "Honor (respect, obey, care for) your father and your mother, so that your days may be prolonged in the land the LORD your God gives you.
AMP.13: "You shall not commit murder (unjustified, deliberate homicide).
AMP.15: "You shall not steal [secretly, openly, fraudulently, or through carelessness].
AMP.16: "You shall not testify falsely [that is, lie, withhold, or manipulate the truth] against your neighbor (any person).
AMP.17: "You shall not covet [that is, selfishly desire and attempt to acquire] your neighbor's house; you shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his male servant, or his female servant, or his ox, or his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."
AMP.18: Now all the people witnessed the thunder and the flashes of lightning and the sound of the trumpet and the smoking mountain; and as they looked, the people were afraid, and they trembled [and moved backward] and stood at a [safe] distance.
AMP.19: Then they said to Moses, "You speak to us and we will listen, but do not let God speak to us or we will die."
AMP.20: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid; for God has come in order to test you, and in order that the fear of Him [that is, a profound reverence for Him] will remain with you, so that you do not sin."
AMP.21: So the people stood at a [safe] distance, but Moses approached the thick cloud where God was.
AMP.22: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the Israelites, 'You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
AMP.23: You shall not make other gods [to worship] besides Me; gods of silver or gods of gold, you shall not make [these lifeless idols] for yourselves.
AMP.24: You shall make an altar of earth for Me, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I cause My Name to be recorded and remembered [through revelation of My divine nature] I will come to you and bless you.
AMP.25: If you make an altar of stone for Me, you shall not build it of cut stones, for if you use a chisel on it, you will profane it.
AMP.26: Nor shall you go up to My altar on steps, so that your nakedness will not be exposed on it.'

NIV.1:
The Ten Commandments
And God spoke all these words:
NIV.2: “I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.
NIV.3: “You shall have no other gods before me.
NIV.4: “You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.
NIV.5: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,
NIV.6: but showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments.
NIV.7: “You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.
NIV.8: “Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
NIV.9: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
NIV.10: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your animals, nor the alien within your gates.
NIV.11: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.
NIV.12: “Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
NIV.16: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
NIV.17: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
NIV.18: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance
NIV.19: and said to Moses, “Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die.”
NIV.20: Moses said to the people, “Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning.”
NIV.21: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
NIV.22:
Idols and Altars
Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites this: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:
NIV.23: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.
NIV.24: “‘Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.
NIV.25: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.
NIV.26: And do not go up to my altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
